title: Glauber dynamics for random field Ising models on bounded degree graphs and MLSI
summary: We study the ferromagnetic random field Ising model (RFIM) on a graph $G=(V,E)$ having maximal degree $Δ$, where the external field at each vertex is an i.i.d. random variable. When the random field distribution is sufficiently anti-concentrated, we prove that with high probability over the quenched randomness of the external field, the Glauber dynamics of this RFIM mixes in polynomial time as a consequence of a Poincaré inequality.
